manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the gum bottle on the red card.

Task description: The target is the green-and-white gum bottle lying on the table. Pick it up and place it on the red card currently to its right.

Success criteria: The gum bottle has been picked up and placed on the red card, in contact with it, and remains on the card after the gripper opens.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a relatively straight section around the middle of the bottle body, away from the end flanges. Close across its long axis to reduce misalignment, rolling, or slipping.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the bottle. Before closing, confirm that the fingers enclose opposite sides and the fingertips are not against the table, avoiding pressing only on top and pushing the bottle to roll.
- Keep the secure grasp pose during transport and leave clearance between the bottle's lower edge and the table, avoiding dragging on the table or bumping the red card.
- Leave enough clearance between the bottle and card edge at the placement point. Release slowly after the bottle contacts and is supported by the card; if placing it horizontally, watch for rolling so it does not roll off.

I have read the manual and confirmed the target bottle is lying on its side to the left of the red card. Only the right arm is available. I am adjusting the gripper at a high position and aligning gradually using both camera views.

The gripper has gradually turned over the bottle; the bottle and card positions remain stable. Next I will continue lowering and correcting clearance on both sides, switching to steps no greater than 1 cm near the contact region.

An orientation adjustment hit a joint limit, and the tool returned a recoverable rejection. I adjusted the approach using the new measured pose. The gripper is now aligned with the bottle body and descending in 1-cm steps, checking clearance each time.
The bottle body is between the fingers, but the gripper has not closed yet. I am adjusting the grasp height, then will make a small test lift before carrying it to the red card.

The bottle rose with the gripper, gradually turning from horizontal to vertical. The measured opening remains about 59 mm. I will continue confirming bottom clearance and grasp stability before lateral movement.

I observed the bottle base clear the table, and it remains held during lateral movement. I am moving it to the center of the red card, then will lower gradually and release only after it is supported.

The bottle has been moved near the center of the red card, and the grasp remains stable. I am now in the final slow descent phase and will release only after confirming the bottle base touches the card.
The gripper is fully open, and the bottle remains upright on the red card. Next I will withdraw slightly and recheck stability, then end this episode.
